title: Decision memo that says only anonymous aggregates are shared, while its own appendix holds names, emails and balances

planted.why: the memo says no names or identifiers are shared, but the sample export contains account ids, names, emails and balances

proof.python:
import re
t = open('memo.md').read()
assert 'Only aggregated, anonymous data' in t
assert re.search(r'[\w.]+@example\.test', t) and 'balance_usd' in t
